X, Y, and Z are three points on a plane with XY = 11 cm, YZ = 13 cm, and XZ = 24 cm. The number of circles that travel through points X, Y, and Z is:
questions.solution_en:
Given XY=11 cm

YZ=13 cm

XZ=24 cm

Formula used:-

For three points to lie on a circle, the sum of the lengths of any two sides must be greater than the length of the third side.

Calculation

Checking the triangle inequality for the given lengths:

XY + YZ > XZ

11 + 13>24 (not true)

XY + XZ > YZ

11 + 24> 13 (true)

YZ + XZ> XY

13 + 24>11 (True)

As one of them is "not true", Points X,Y,Z do not form a valid triangle and hence do not lie on a circle.

So the number of circles that can pass through points X,Y and Z is zero.

Option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: A team of 5 members is to be chosen from a group of 6 male employees and 5 female employees. In how many ways 3 male employees and 2 female employees of the team can be choose?
questions.solution_en:
Total number of male and female employees are 6 and 5 respectively.

Total number of ways in which 5 members of the team can be choose = 6C3 * 5C2

= (6!/3!) * (5!/3!)

= [(6*5*4*3*2*1)/(3*2*1)] * [(5*4*3*2*1)/(3*2*1)]

= 120 * 20

= 2400

Three pipes P, Q and R together can fill a tank in 30 hours and pipe P alone can fill the tank in 80 hours. In how many hours, pipes Q and R together can fill the tank?
questions.solution_en:
Total capacity = LCM of 30 and 80 = 240 units

Part filled by pipe P, Q and R together = 240/30 = 8 units/hour

Part filled by pipe P = 240/80 = 3 units/hour

Time taken by pipes Q and R together to fill the tank = 240/(8 - 3) = 48 hours

questions.q_en: The LCM of two numbers is 7 times the larger number. If the difference between smaller number and HCF of the numbers is 72, then find the HCF of the numbers.
questions.solution_en:
Let smaller and larger number be 'm' and 'n' respectively.

So, LCM and HCF are 7n and (m - 72) respectively.

Since,

HCF * LCM = product of two numbers

(m - 72)*7n = m*n

7m - 504 = m

m = 504/6

m = 84

So, HCF of the numbers = 84 - 72 = 12

questions.q_en: After two years, Pallavi's age was 3 times of Firoz's age. The ratio between Firoz's age 4 years hence and Pallavi's age 5 years hence, will be 4: 11 respectively. If Bhim is 6 years older than Firoz, then what was Bhim's age five years ago?
questions.solution_en:
Let present age of Pallavi and Firoz are (3x - 2) years and (x - 2) years, respectively.

(x - 2 + 4)/(3x - 2 + 5) = 4/11

=> x = 10

Hence, Bhim's age five years ago = (10 - 2 + 6 - 5) = 9 years

A motorboat can row a distance of 5.25 km and return back to starting point in a total of 1.2 hours and the motorboat can cover 1.8 km in still water in 12 minutes. How much time the motorboat takes to cover 25.2 km in downstream?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of the motorboat in still water = 1.8/(12/60) = 9 km/h

Let x km/h be the speed of the stream.

According to the question,

5.25/(9 - x) + 5.25/(9 + x) = 1.2

=> x = 1.5 km/h

So, downstream speed of the motorboat = 9 + 1.5 = 10.5 km/h

Hence, required time = 25.2/10.5 = 2.4 hours

questions.q_en: The number of students in class P and class Q of a school are 50 and 60 respectively. The average marks in a subject of all the students is 91. If the average marks of the students in class P is 40% more than that of students in class Q, then what is the average marks of students in class Q?
questions.solution_en:
Let average marks of the students in class Q = m

Total marks of all the students of class P and Q together = Total marks of all the students of class P + Total marks of all the students of class Q

=> 91*(50 + 60) = 50*1.4m + 60*m

=> m = 91*110/(70 + 60)

=> m = 77

questions.q_en: Priyanka travels at the speed of 45 kmph for 5.4 hours and 39 kmph for 7 hours. In this way she covers four-fifths of the distance. At what average speed should she travel to cover the remaining distance in 3 hours?
questions.solution_en:
Let the total distance = X km

She travels the distance = 45*5.4 + 39*7 = 516 km

According to the question, 516 km is four-fifths of the total distance.

Therefore, 4X/5 = 516 km

X = 516*5/4 = 645 km

Remaining distance = 645 - 516 = 129 km

Hence average speed = 129/3 = 43 kmph

questions.q_en: A solid toy is in the form of a hemisphere surmounted by a right circular cone. Height of the cone is 2cm and the diameter of the base is 4cm. If a right circular cylinder circumscribes the solid, find how much more space it will cover.
questions.solution_en:
Let BPC be the hemisphere and ABC be the cone standing on the base of the hemisphere.

Radius BO of the hemisphere (as well as of the cone) = ½ * 4 = 2 cm

Now, let right circular cylinder EFGH circumscribe the given solid, radius of the base of the right circular cylinder = HP = BO = 2 cm

Height of the cylinder = AP = AO + OP

= 2cm + 2cm = 4 cm

Now, Volume of the right circular cylinder - Volume of the solid

= (π * 22 * 4 - (2/3 * π * 23 + 1/3* π * 22 * 2)) cm3

= (16π - 8π) cm3

= 8π cm3
